title: Prognostic Value of Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Assessment of Structural Heart Disease
summary: How well can a heart MRI predict the risk of sudden cardiac death—depending on the type of heart disease?
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
clinically indicated heart MRT
Exclusion criteria:
contraindication for MRT or gadolinium
